r8.scope: Observation while R8 owns UI reading changes; not a whole-source freeze and not a new engine/UI test acceptance.

limits: S2 post marker excludes itself; current identity and this check before/after equality are recorded. No earlier independent post-marker hash is claimed.

P3 historical tracked/untracked labels are carried from the original report; current Git classification and P3 functional tests are not checked. Eight script hashes prove equality to the sealed S2 final observation, not its previously unrecorded pre-S2 bytes.
Prefix manifest records bytes and SHA only; current modes are observed but historical mode equality is not claimed. Hash preservation is not a new engine/Create replay acceptance.
Master original prefix equality preserves its pre-existing P3 text. This check does not rederive a 14-line Git diff from HEAD or inspect/stage the index.
